verses.text: “Even today my complaint is bitter. His hand is heavy despite my groaning.

xrefs.text: [“]I loathe my own life; I will express my complaint and speak in the bitterness of my soul.
For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
Therefore I will not restrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
and disclose to you the secrets of wisdom, for true wisdom has two sides. Know then that God exacts from you less than your iniquity deserves.
In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.

verses.text: If only I knew where to find Him, so that I could go to His seat.

xrefs.text: Oh, that a man might plead with God as he pleads with his neighbor!
Yet I desire to speak to the Almighty and argue my case before God.
Although our iniquities testify against us, O LORD, act for the sake of Your name. Indeed, our rebellions are many; we have sinned against You.
(Oh, that I had one to hear me! Here is my signature. Let the Almighty answer me; let my accuser compose an indictment.
Since, then, it remains for some to enter His rest, and since those who formerly heard the good news did not enter because of their disobedience,

verses.text: I would plead my case before Him and fill my mouth with arguments.

xrefs.text: See now, I have prepared my case; I know that I will be vindicated.

Incline Your ear, O my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears Your name. For we are not presenting our petitions before You because of our righteous acts, but because of Your great compassion.

Far be it from You to do such a thing— to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous and the wicked are treated alike. Far be it from You! Will not the Judge of all the earth do what is right?”
O Lord, what can I say, now that Israel has turned its back and run from its enemies?
Remind Me, let us argue the matter together. State your case, so that you may be vindicated.

verses.text: I would learn how He would answer, and consider what He would say.

xrefs.text: I will say to God: Do not condemn me! Let me know why You prosecute me.
Then call me, and I will answer, or let me speak, and You can reply.
I care very little, however, if I am judged by you or by any human court. In fact, I do not even judge myself.
“I know that You can do all things and that no plan of Yours can be thwarted.

verses.text: Would He contend with me in His great power? No, He would certainly take note of me.

xrefs.text: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness. Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
Nor is there a mediator between us, to lay his hand upon us both.
Withdraw Your hand from me, and do not let Your terror frighten me.
God is wise in heart and mighty in strength. Who has resisted Him and prospered?
I am not angry. If only thorns and briers confronted Me, I would march and trample them, I would burn them to the ground.

verses.text: Then an upright man could reason with Him, and I would be delivered forever from my Judge.

xrefs.text: Yet I desire to speak to the Almighty and argue my case before God.
Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
“Come now, let us reason together,” says the LORD. “Though your sins are like scarlet, they will be as white as snow; though they are as red as crimson, they will become like wool.
Will He be angry forever? Will He be indignant to the end?’ This you have spoken, but you keep doing all the evil you can.”
Who will bring any charge against God’s elect? It is God who justifies.

verses.text: If I go east, He is not there, and if I go west, I cannot find Him.

xrefs.text: Were He to pass by me, I would not see Him; were He to move, I would not recognize Him.
Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide in times of trouble?
How much less, then, when you say that you do not see Him, that your case is before Him and you must wait for Him,
He alone is immortal and dwells in unapproachable light. No one has ever seen Him, nor can anyone see Him. To Him be honor and eternal dominion! Amen.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?

verses.text: When He is at work in the north, I cannot behold Him; when He turns to the south, I cannot see Him.

xrefs.text: How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
I will wait for the LORD, who is hiding His face from the house of Jacob. I will put my trust in Him.

verses.text: Yet He knows the way I have taken; when He has tested me, I will come forth as gold.

xrefs.text: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.
so that the proven character of your faith— more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire— may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and known me.

This third I will bring through the fire; I will refine them like silver and test them like gold. They will call on My name, and I will answer them. I will say, ‘They are My people,’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is our God.’”

verses.text: My feet have followed in His tracks; I have kept His way without turning aside.

xrefs.text: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.
My steps have held to Your paths; my feet have not slipped.

If indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, only to be entangled and overcome by it again, their final condition is worse than it was at first.
To those who by perseverance in doing good seek glory, honor, and immortality, He will give eternal life.
Yet a righteous one holds to his way, and the one with clean hands grows stronger.

verses.text: I have not departed from the command of His lips; I have treasured the words of His mouth more than my daily bread.

xrefs.text: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words became my joy and my heart’s delight. For I bear Your name, O LORD God of Hosts.
I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!
Jesus explained, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.
The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.

verses.text: But He is unchangeable, and who can oppose Him? He does what He desires.

xrefs.text: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.
Many plans are in a man’s heart, but the purpose of the LORD will prevail.
I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times what is still to come. I say, ‘My purpose will stand, and all My good pleasure I will accomplish.’

All the peoples of the earth are counted as nothing, and He does as He pleases with the army of heaven and the peoples of the earth. There is no one who can restrain His hand or say to Him, ‘What have You done?’”
What He tears down cannot be rebuilt; the man He imprisons cannot be released.

verses.text: For He carries out His decree against me, and He has many such plans.

xrefs.text: so that none of you would be shaken by these trials. For you know that we are destined for this.
For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.
Why do you say, O Jacob, and why do you assert, O Israel, “My way is hidden from the LORD, and my claim is ignored by my God”?
O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!

verses.text: Therefore I am terrified in His presence; when I consider this, I fear Him.

xrefs.text: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments.
For calamity from God terrifies me, and His splendor I cannot overpower.
I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah
If only I knew where to find Him, so that I could go to His seat.
I heard and trembled within; my lips quivered at the sound. Decay entered my bones; I trembled where I stood. Yet I must wait patiently for the day of distress to come upon the people who invade us.

verses.text: God has made my heart faint; the Almighty has terrified me.

xrefs.text: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.
“As surely as God lives, who has deprived me of justice— the Almighty, who has embittered my soul—
saying to them, “Hear, O Israel, today you are going into battle with your enemies. Do not be fainthearted or afraid; do not be alarmed or terrified because of them.
Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.
Then I said: “Woe is me, for I am ruined, because I am a man of unclean lips dwelling among a people of unclean lips; for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Hosts.”

verses.text: Yet I am not silenced by the darkness, by the thick darkness that covers my face.

xrefs.text: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass; He has veiled my paths with darkness.
The righteous perish, and no one takes it to heart; devout men are taken away, while no one considers that the righteous are taken away from the presence of evil.

‘Therefore I will indeed gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the calamity that I will bring on this place.’” So they brought her answer back to the king.
